name: exam-seating
title: Exam seating plan
prompt:
Implement `assign(students, rooms)` in `seating.py` for exam seating.
- `students`: list of `{"id": str, "group": str}`; `rooms`: list of `{"name": str, "rows": int, "cols": int}`
- return a dict `student id -> (room name, row, col)` (0-based row/col)
- every student gets exactly one seat inside a room's bounds; no seat is used twice
- two students of the SAME group must never sit side by side in the same row
  (same room, same row, columns differing by 1); seats may be left empty to achieve this
- raise `ValueError` if a valid plan is impossible (not enough seats, or a group too large to
  separate), if a student id is duplicated, or if a room has rows/cols < 1
